Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting lake management districts from business and occupation tax.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to lake management districts; and adding a newsection to chapter 82.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does to apply to lake management districts createdunder chapter 36.61 RCW.
